study: Mattera et al. 2018, Making Pre-K Count (Building Blocks curriculum + PD) +/- High 5s K supplement, end-of-K outcomes (MDRC)
eval_evidence: Evaluation conducted by MDRC, which also operated the program: MDRC ran Making Pre-K Count and 'developed' the High 5s supplement ('Making Pre-K Count and High 5s were developed in a partnership between the Robin Hood Foundation... and MDRC'). MDRC thus has a program/operator stake (esp. for the High 5s/Comparison 3 contrast), so coded developer. (The underlying Building Blocks curriculum itself was developed by Clements & Sarama.)
developer_evidence: PD delivery was not done by MDRC or the Building Blocks authors directly: 'our partners at Bank Street College... provided coaching, facilitation, and supervision'; Clements & Sarama provided ongoing consultation only. Bank Street coaches delivered the teacher coaching.
cascade_evidence: Extra hop: Building Blocks developers (Clements/Sarama) consulted, and Bank Street College coaches (an intermediary partner) provided the in-class coaching/facilitation to the pre-K teachers, rather than the developers coaching teachers directly.
counterfactual_evidence: Control = 'pre-K-as-usual' / 'pre-K-and-kindergarten-as-usual' with no math enrichment; true BAU comparison (Comparisons 1 and 3).
coaching_evidence: Teachers received training and coaching over two years and 'met with coaches two to four times a month' (Bank Street coaches); recurring (>=monthly) in-class coaching cycles.
student_dose_evidence: Comparison 3 (row 76, MPC + High 5s) adds High 5s: 'supplemental small-group math clubs, which took place outside of regular instructional time' (~12 added math minutes/morning) = a direct student-facing pull-out dose. NOTE: Comparison 1 (row 75, MPC alone) has NO student dose (curriculum + teacher PD only); the student_component applies specifically to the High 5s arm.
maturity_evidence: 'Program impacts were assessed in the second year of implementation, after teachers were comfortable with the curriculum' (MPC began fall 2013, two years of implementation); teachers experienced with Building Blocks by the measurement wave.
